• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
• We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Who We Are:

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Binchotan Bar & Grille is where fireside cooking meets modern flair. At Fairmont Orchid’s hottest new restaurant guests explore the long-running creative culinary exchange between Hawai’i and Japan at our Traditional northern Japanese grill utilizing centuries-old practices of robatayaki: fireside cooking, grilled to perfection. Originating from Hokkaidō, Japan, robatayaki reflects the seafaring lifestyle: seasoned fishermen grilling up their fresh catch over the irori, or glowing white coals, served sizzling hot.

What you will be doing:

• Provide unique dining experiences to all of our guests through warm, personal & detailed service in a luxury, upscale and fast paced environment.
• Ensure a positive first impression of the restaurant for our guests through detailed cleanliness, set-up and ambiance control.
• Maintain complete knowledge of all F&B services, contents & preparation methods, outlets and hotel services/features
• Clean, set and re-set tables continuously, assuming responsibility for station, tables and side duties.
• Serve water, bread, coffee and greet guests by name whenever possible during the course of meal service to personalize service
• Assist server with clearing of courses as meals progress.
• Stack trays properly for efficient & effective unloading
• Clear and tidy up tables after the departure of the patrons as quickly as possible.
• Perform opening/closing side duties as assigned and set all tables according to standards and procedures
• Assist other Food & Beverage outlets with their operations during peak times or when required
• Apply necessary precautions with regards to the hotel food safety and hygiene standards (HACCP)
• Be well versed in hotel fire & life safety/emergency procedures
• Maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene at all times
• Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Management of the Hotel

Your experience and skills include:

• Ability to focus attention on guest needs, remaining calm and courteous at all times
• Good reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language
• Ability to speak other languages and basic understanding of local languages will be an advantage
• Ability to work cohesively and collaboratively as part of a team
• Detailed & service oriented with an eye for detail to be self-motivated and energetic.
• Provide the necessary State and Federal Requirements to work in Food and Beverage (Tuberculosis Clearance)

Hourly Rate: $20.00 USD + tips

Visa Requirements: Must be legally eligible to work in the United States. The hotel is unable to assist candidates in obtaining U.S. work authorization.

Your team and working environment: Join a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional luxury experiences. You will work alongside passionate Heartists who support one another, anticipate guest needs, and bring our commitment to Make Special Happen to life every day.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

Why work for Accor?

We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality.

We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.

By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/

About Fairmont Hotels & Resorts: At Fairmont Hotels & Resorts we offer our guests the finest hospitality experience in each of our destinations. And we know that, to offer our guests the best, we first need to offer our employees the best. That’s why you’ll find exceptional work opportunities – throughout North America and the Caribbean, Europe and Africa, the Middle East and Asia Pacific – as well as industry leading training, career development, recognition and rewards. Fairmont Hotels & Resorts is a celebrated collection of hotel that includes landmark locations like London’s The Savoy, New York’s The Plaza, and Shanghai’s Fairmont Peace Hotel. Our teams are guided by values of Respect, Integrity, Teamwork and Empowerment; we employ the highest ethical and quality standards, treating all colleague with fairness & dignity. A community and environmental leader, Fairmont is also regarded for its responsible tourism practices and award – winning Green Partnership Program. An exciting future awaits!

Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Merchant
jobs.description:
At Mudflap, we're modernizing the $1 trillion trucking industry, the backbone of the U.S. economy. By helping over 100,000 underserved small businesses save over $1.5 billion on fuel, Mudflap has quickly grown into a profitable fintech platform that processes billions in annual payment volume.



As a Senior Product Manager, Merchant, you will own how Mudflap builds products and experiences for the merchants at the heart of our marketplace. You’ll spend significant time directly with our merchant partners, developing a deep understanding of their businesses, identifying opportunities to create value for both merchants and carriers, and turning those insights into product strategy.



This is a highly external, relationship-driven product role. We’re looking for someone who can independently build credibility with sophisticated partners while bringing the product judgment to look beyond individual requests and identify bigger opportunities. You might hear a merchant describe a business challenge and see the opportunity for a new capability, a better workflow, or a new way for merchants to use pricing and promotions to drive customer behavior.



You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and our merchant-facing teams to determine where Mudflap should invest and turn those opportunities into products that strengthen our marketplace.



Work Location: This role is based in Palo Alto and involves a hybrid work approach, balancing in-office collaboration with the ability to work remotely.



To support our team, we offer:

 - Commuter benefits to ease your travel

 - Lunches and snacks to keep you fueled

 - A collaborative, high-growth environment where you’ll work closely with talented teammates across the company



Expectations (In this role, you will):

 - Build trusted relationships with merchant partners, independently leading product conversations and uncovering opportunities to better serve their businesses

 - Develop and own the strategy and roadmap for merchant-facing products and experiences

 - Translate merchant feedback into broader insights, distinguishing one-off requests from scalable product opportunities

 - Proactively identify new ways to create value for merchants and carriers, including pricing, promotions, incentives, and other marketplace capabilities

 - Partner closely with Engineering and cross-functional teams from discovery and strategy through launch and iteration

 - Use customer insights, data, and strong product judgment to prioritize opportunities and measure impact



Experience (What we look for):

 - Experience with merchant payments infrastructure, including POS systems, transaction processing, settlement, or related financial workflows

 - Significant product management experience, ideally owning complex marketplace, merchant, logistics, freight, or payments products

 - Experience working directly with merchants, enterprise partners, or sophisticated external customers

 - Strong product judgment and a track record of identifying opportunities beyond what customers explicitly ask for

 - Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how products create value for customers, partners, and the business

 - Ability to build credibility with external partners and independently lead strategic product conversations

 - Strong cross-functional leadership with the ability to operate autonomously and move quickly in ambiguity



Perks and Benefits (What we offer):

 - Competitive salary and equity in a high-growth startup

 - Multiple health benefit options

 - Responsible Time Off

 - 401(k) matching

 - Opportunities and support for major career growth

 - Annual Company offsite event (Mudfest!)



The salary range for this role is $215,000 – $238,000. This information reflects a base salary range for this position based on current market data, which may be subject to change as new market data becomes available. The candidate's skills, experience, and other relevant factors will determine the exact compensation.



Company Overview (Who we are):

Mudflap is on a mission to transform the trucking and logistics industry by leveling the playing field for owner operators and small fleets. Backed by top-tier venture investors, including QED, Matrix Partners, Commerce Ventures, NFX, and 500 Startups and included in the Forbes Fintech 50 list, Mudflap offers fleet fuel management solutions. Our core team hails from Disney, Uber, Procore, DoorDash, Google, Meta, Capital One, Affirm and Brex.



Here are the core values that we believe in and look for in new teammates:

 - Be Customer Obsessed: We deeply understand customer needs and put our customers at the center of everything we do

 - Make it Count: Act like an owner by focusing on the impact of your work

 - Find a Way: Be a creative problem solver who pushes past roadblocks to win for our customers and our teammates

 - Sweat the Details: We keep our standards high and achieve them by paying attention to every detail

 - Be Curious: Use a growth mindset to question assumptions, take calculated risks and stretch the boundaries of what’s possible

jobs.title: Senior Construction Design Engineer
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Construction Design & Delivery team is at the core of Relativity’s growth and development. Through our collaboration and expertise, we deliver projects that lay the foundation for Relativity’s future success. In essence, we build the factory that builds the rockets! We are responsible for cross functional relationships with teams such as Manufacturing, Propulsion, PBF, Avionics, Machine Shop, Facilities, EHS and Security to name a few, working through design specifications and execution of critical infrastructure projects that supports the mission of work centers. Our relationships don’t stop there, working daily with government agencies, utility suppliers, vendors and contractors who support our factory build out. Our team ensures that all projects meet operational requirements, safety and environmental codes, all the while remaining within budget, delivering on time, and to the highest quality as we help to drive production forward.

About the Role:

• Lead end-to-end infrastructure project design at the Wormhole factory—from concept development through permit issuance and construction handoff

• Translate operational requirements into buildable, code-compliant design packages across architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and civil disciplines

• Serve as the central point of coordination for stakeholder engagement, consultant management, and cross-functional design integration

• Drive development of work center layouts in collaboration with Manufacturing Engineers and CAD teams to meet equipment, utility, and compliance needs

• Manage design-phase budgets, soft cost estimates, and change tracking in partnership with project controls and estimating teams

• Provide construction administration support including submittal reviews, RFI responses, site walks, and punchlist validation to ensure design intent is maintained

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related technical discipline

• 5+ years of experience leading capital or infrastructure projects through design, permitting, and construction phases

• Strong knowledge of building codes, fire/life safety, Title 24, and permitting requirements

• Proven ability to manage consultant deliverables, coordinate interdisciplinary design reviews, and facilitate stakeholder alignment

• Proficiency in reviewing construction documents, redlines, and QA/QC deliverables for scope clarity and constructability

• Organized communicator skilled at producing clear meeting notes, action trackers, and handoff packages for execution teams

Nice to haves but not required:

• PE license or PMP certification

• Experience working in regulated manufacturing environments or cleanroom infrastructure projects

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

Hiring Range:

$122,000—$182,000 USD

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at accommodations@relativityspace.com.

Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - AI Search
jobs.description:
This is a dynamic role where you will drive quality and development excellence across the entire software development lifecycle, from initial design and coding to comprehensive test automation and deployment. You will be responsible for both building high-quality product features and ensuring their reliability, scalability, and performance.

The Team

Come join the AI Search UX team and work with a talented group of engineers building out next-generation technologies in the ServiceNow cloud platform. This team is responsible for the cognitive, actionable search functionality and machine learning-based relevancy that help make ServiceNow a powerful platform used by many Fortune 500 companies.

Key Responsibilities

Software Development & Architecture

• Build high-quality, clean, scalable, and reusable code by enforcing best practices around software engineering, architecture, and processes.

• Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while also enhancing the existing product suite.

• Implement software that is simple to use, allowing customers to extend and customize the functionality to meet their specific needs.

• Utilize experience with Java development using object-oriented methodologies and understanding of software design patterns, algorithms, and data structures.

• Create and maintain Client Scripts, UI Policies, Business Rules, and Script Includes using client and server APIs to build and support AI Search’s administrative tools within the company platform.

• Create and maintain search-related UI components using the company’s UI JavaScript/HTML/CSS framework, adhering to best practices for user experience and accessibility.

• Develop and maintain analytics dashboards, including designing database schema and data transformation and loading of required data.

• Modify the GraphQL, Java, and scriptable APIs exposed by AI Search to introduce new functionality and address defects.

• Provide technical support for customer-reported search-UI/UX issues.

• Build and maintain a highly interactive, intuitive, easy-to-use admin UI for new, innovative search and machine learning/understanding capabilities that is extensible and easy to maintain.

• Apply new technology and innovation to improve platform functionality.

Engineering & Test Automation

• Own your code from design through delivery, including comprehensive test automation to ensure the delivery of high-quality products to our users.

• Create, execute, and maintain scripts and tools for various testing frameworks.

• Work with quality testing frameworks and tools including Java, Jenkins, JUnit, Playwright, and Selenium.

• Create and maintain manual test plans, test suites, and test cases for end-to-end testing.

• Contribute to improving QA processes, ensuring test cases are documented, and test results are published.

• Assist in setting up test instances with multiple upgrade paths to support broader testing efforts.

Collaboration & Process

• Work closely with Product Owners to understand detailed requirements and define acceptance criteria.

• Participate in all Agile SCRUM ceremonies, including grooming sessions, to identify key requirements and design the integrated test plan.

• Contribute to cross-team technical discussions and decision-making.

• Collaborate with other teams to ensure cross-product dependencies are factored into test cases and lend assistance to ensure collective success.

To be successful in this role you have:

• Experience in leveraging critical thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
• 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality products.
• Proficiency in Python, Java, or similar object-oriented languages.
• Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.
• Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization
• Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, TestNG) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines
• Understanding software quality principles including reliability, observability, and production readiness.
• Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and optimize performance across the stack.
• Experience with AI-powered tools or workflows, including validation of datasets, model predictions, and inference consistency.
• Comfort with development tools such as IDEs, debuggers, profilers, source control, and Unix-based systems

Why Join Us

• Build and deliver high-impact software that powers digital experiences for millions of users.
• Collaborate in a culture that values craftsmanship, quality, and innovation.
• Work symbiotically with AI and automation tools that enhance engineering excellence and drive product reliability.
• Be part of a culture that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and shared success.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $166,500 - $291,400, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

About Us

The Honest Company (NASDAQ: HNST) is a personal care company dedicated to creating cleanly-formulated and sustainably-designed products spanning categories across diapers, wipes, baby personal care, beauty, apparel, household care and wellness. Launched in 2012, the Company is on a mission to challenge ingredients, ideals, and industries through the power of the Honest brand, the Honest team, and the Honest Standard. For more information about the Honest Standard and the Company, please visit www.honest.com.

Our Mission

We're on a mission to empower people to live happy, healthy lives. We're a wellness brand with values rooted in consciousness, community, transparency, and design. Every day and in every way, we hold ourselves to an Honest standard. We believe that it is our responsibility to do our part to help create a healthy and sustainable future for all.

The Role

The Honest Company is looking for a Contract Recruiter in a full-time capacity. This is a four-month contract role starting in September 2026 and running through the end of the year. This is a critical role that will have a tremendous impact on Honest’s business as the company continues to scale and grow. This individual will assist with all aspects of recruiting and hiring and provide support to candidates at each stage of the recruiting process to ensure best in class candidate experience. Individuals must have full-cycle recruiting experience in a fast paced environment with exceptional skills in sourcing passive candidates, selling Honest’s mission, negotiating and closing offers, and managing multiple positions across multiple verticals.

What you’ll do:

• Own full-cycle recruiting across multiple departments, including Marketing, Sales, Finance/Accounting, Operations, R&D, Technology, and Creative.

• Act as a business partner and resource to various hiring managers at all levels throughout the recruiting process from start to finish and establish recruiting strategies that fill existing and future openings.

• Manage the entire recruiting life cycle from intake meetings, phone screens through offer management, and on-boarding.

• Proactively communicate to hiring managers, candidates, and People Team providing timely updates on recruiting progress and challenges.

• Manage the interview process: act as a host for candidates, keep interviews on schedule, and provide office tours.

• Create and enhance job descriptions ensuring that they are clear, concise, relevant, and effective in attracting relevant candidates.

• Establish passive talent pools through LinkedIn and have the ability to convert passive candidates to Honest job opportunities.

• Manage all open requisitions via Greenhouse ensuring that all data is updated and accurate.

• Act with a sense of urgency to meet quarterly hiring goals while maintaining a high bar for talent.

• Creatively assisting in team's talent brand, sourcing, and recruiting strategies identifying opportunities that will help attract the best talent in the market.

• Assist with Talent Acquisition and HR programs and initiatives as needed.

You’ll love this job if you’re:

• A talented juggler. You successfully manage competing priorities, and you make it look easy

• Passionate about recruiting. You're consistently brainstorming new ways to improve candidate experience

• Flexible. You can change direction quickly and easily adapt to curveballs

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, fluid environment. You're calm under pressure and think quickly on your feet

• Adaptable and ambitious. You will enthusiastically take on other assignments as needed to support your team!

What you’ll need:

• 3+ years of full-time experience in full-cycle recruiting

• Ability to handle confidential information with care and professionalism

• Extensive experience using LinkedIn Recruiter to identify passive candidates

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to take initiative and build strong relationships quickly

• Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills

• Ability to manage multiple initiatives and responsibilities in parallel

• Strong ATS experience (e.g., Greenhouse) and proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Proven track record of supporting multiple high-touch hiring managers, managing repetitive requisitions, and running multiple projects simultaneously

• Skilled in coordinating virtual interview processes via Zoom, ensuring smooth scheduling, link management, and timely follow-ups

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $40–$50 per hour. Actual compensation is based on many factors including but not limited to depth of experience, skill level, ability, knowledge, education, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.description:
What you get to do in this role

We are looking for a Senior Manager of Machine Learning Engineering to lead a team building the next generation of AI Search and Retrieval capabilities that power intelligent experiences across the ServiceNow platform including Conversational and Agentic experiences.

You will lead engineers and machine learning practitioners responsible for designing and delivering highly scalable search, retrieval, ranking, recommendation, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems that enable users to discover information, generate insights, and accomplish work more effectively.

This leader will collaborate closely with Product Management, Applied AI, Platform Engineering, UX, and Quality Engineering to define strategy, execute roadmap commitments, and deliver AI-powered experiences that serve millions of users globally.

You will play a critical role in advancing the technologies powering ServiceNow AI Search, Knowledge Retrieval, and GenAI experiences, while building a high-performing engineering culture focused on innovation, quality, and business impact.

Responsibilities

• Lead and grow a team of software engineers and machine learning engineers building large-scale AI Search and retrieval systems.
• Drive the strategy, architecture, and execution for Search, Ranking, Relevance, Personalization, and RAG capabilities.
• Partner with Product Managers and architects to define and deliver innovative AI-powered experiences.
• Build scalable retrieval pipelines leveraging vector search, semantic search, ranking models, and large language models.
• Improve relevance, precision, recall, and overall search quality across structured and unstructured enterprise content.
• Establish architectural patterns for highly available, resilient, and performant distributed systems.
• Lead the development and production deployment of machine learning models and retrieval services at enterprise scale.
• Drive operational excellence, reliability, observability, and performance optimization across the platform.
• Mentor engineering leaders and individual contributors while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate emerging AI technologies and accelerate their adoption into customer-facing products.
• Balance short-term delivery goals with long-term technical investments and platform evolution.

To be successful in this role you have:

• 12+ years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 10+ years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience.
• 3+ years of engineering management experience leading high-performing technical teams.
• Strong expertise in Java or Python and large-scale distributed systems.
• Hands-on experience with Search technologies such as Lucene, Elasticsearch, Solr, OpenSearch, Algolia, Coveo, Glean, or similar platforms.
• Experience building and operating large-scale retrieval, ranking, recommendation, or search systems.
• Experience with modern AI/ML technologies, including LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
• Strong understanding of information retrieval, search relevance, ranking algorithms, and semantic search.
• Experience deploying and operating machine learning models in production environments.
• Knowledge of cloud-native architectures, microservices, observability, and performance optimization.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to influence across engineering and product organizations.
• Proven track record of delivering innovative products from concept through production at enterprise scale.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building enterprise search, knowledge retrieval, or GenAI products.
• Experience with personalization, recommendation systems, or relevance optimization.
• Experience working with vector search technologies and embedding frameworks.
• Experience leading geographically distributed engineering teams.
• Experience integrating AI capabilities into customer-facing SaaS products.

Why this role is exciting

• Own a critical part of ServiceNow's AI platform strategy.
• Influence how millions of users discover knowledge and interact with AI-powered experiences.
• Lead a team at the intersection of Search, Machine Learning, and Agentic platform.
• Partner with world-class engineers, researchers, and product leaders.
• Help shape the future of AI-driven enterprise productivity.

Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. jobs.title: Mission Execution Lead (US)
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

This role is responsible for driving CHAOS’ growth across the United States by aligning our technical capabilities with the operational needs of military and commercial customers. You will lead high-impact engagements end-to-end—opening doors, shaping requirements, securing commitments, and guiding post-award implementation. Your success depends on staying close to the customer, present in their environment, and engaged at every stage of the mission.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined planner, a skilled coordinator, and a flawless executor—someone who thrives in dynamic operational settings and knows how to translate field requirements into decisive action. You should be just as comfortable in a suit and tie as you are stepping out of a tactical vehicle. Just as important, you must be a true team player: someone who collaborates seamlessly with engineering, leadership, and fellow operators to drive shared success and ensure unified delivery.

Expect every day to be different. Stay hungry—seek out problems early, identify gaps before they become failures, and be the first to deliver solutions. This role requires initiative and presence: go where the customer is, build trust, learn continuously, support your team, drive momentum, and execute with absolute precision.

Responsibilities:

• Understand and translate the customer needs. Military and commercial customers are demanding, each operating with their own language, expectations, and mission pressures. This role requires the initiative to seek out opportunities, build trust in the customer’s environment, and translate their needs into clear, actionable requirements for CHAOS. You are the customer’s voice inside CHAOS and CHAOS’ voice in front of the customer—ensuring alignment, clarity, and a unified path to execution.

• Execute, execute, execute. This role is centered on delivering end-to-end execution for the customer. You will coordinate and plan every phase of engagement—from initial site surveys and environmental assessments, to developing and delivering tailored customer training, to running controlled demonstrations and full-scale operational exercises. Success means anticipating requirements, eliminating friction, and ensuring the customer experiences a seamless, confident deployment of CHAOS capabilities.

• Know our product – know the mission. This role operates on CHAOS’ front line. Success requires a deep understanding of our technology, capabilities, and internal resources—and the ability to align them precisely with mission demands and end-user requirements. When executed well, this role becomes the bridge that makes CHAOS the customer’s most trusted and reliable tactical partner.

• Get out of the office. Be wherever the customer needs us—at corporate headquarters, a military installation, inside the Pentagon, or forward in the field. Build trust by engaging at every level, from tactical operators to senior strategic leaders, learning their challenges and earning their confidence through presence and performance.

Minimum Requirements:

• Problem solving mentality. Fight for information, build a team, be creative, a thought leader and relish the opportunity to take on a difficult problem.

• Program/Project Management: Proven experience in developing requirements, scoping programs, and delivering to customers in the defense industry.

• Enjoy getting your hands dirty – literally: CHAOS is an engineering-first company with a hardware component. This role will involve getting hands-on with hardware in the field with customers.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal. You will interface with customer stakeholders across the entire hierarchy—from day-to-day operators to senior leaders. Your job is to capture their insights, frame them in the right operational context, and deliver them clearly to CHAOS engineering, product management, and senior leadership, ensuring the customer’s voice directly shapes our decisions and capabilities.

• Risk tolerance: We intend to go with our customers to where they need us most to deliver. Hazardous duty pay for approved locations.

• Travel: Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to customer sites across the United States and abroad in support of mission requirements.

• Security Clearance: Active security clearance, or the ability to obtain one.

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience: Radar, RF, sensor, weapons systems, defense technology or communications experience.

• Prior Military Experience: Extensive experience with U.S. military operations, or a background in military engineering or advanced defense technologies.

• Travel experience: Comfortable deploying as part of a team within the United States or overseas to support operational engagements; capable of operating in remote environments and proactively planning for and mitigating risks to reputation, mission, and personnel.

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 350 employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary range: $160,000 - $200,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT RETELL AI

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors, we've scaled to $80M in ARR with a team of 50, up from $5M at the start of 2025, and are now valued at over $1.5B.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI "workers" that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction.

We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world.

Let's build the future together.

Recent recognition:

 - No. 1 Best Places to Work in the Bay Area, San Francisco Business Times 2026 https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/voice-ai-startup-retell-ai-145200025.html

 - Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025) https://a16z.com/the-ai-application-spending-report-where-startup-dollars-really-go/

 - #3 Fastest-Growing Software Company, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://company.g2.com/news/g2s-2026-best-software-awards

 - Best Agentic AI Software, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://www.retellai.com/blog/retell-ai-recognized-as-the-best-agentic-ai-software-by-g2

 - #4 Fastest-Growing Software Vendor, Brex Benchmark 2025 https://www.brex.com/journal/brex-benchmark-december-2025

 - Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC https://www.nasdaq.com/videos/retell-ai

 - Top-Ranked Startup, Lean AI Leaderboard https://leanaileaderboard.com/

 - Backed by Y Combinator https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/retell-ai




ABOUT THE ROLE

We've landed the logos. This role exists because keeping and growing them is now the biggest opportunity. You'll own a book of enterprise accounts from launch onward, the relationship, the consumption number, the renewal, and the expansion. We price on usage, growth here isn't a repapering exercise: you grow the account by getting more of the customer's call volume onto Retell, which means you'll be in the data, in the QBRs, and in the room when they decide what to automate next.




KEY RESPONSIBILITY

This hire owns net revenue retention across a book of enterprise accounts.

 - Own the post-launch relationship with enterprise buyers and program owners, from first production call through renewal.

 - Grow consumption across the book: pilot to production, one use case to many, one department to the org.

 - Own the renewal: forecast, negotiate, and close it, and find the upsell inside it.

 - Turn usage data into the business case customers use internally to expand.

 - Bring the blockers you find back to Product and Engineering with revenue attached.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

 - 2+ years in Account Management, Customer Success Management, or another post-sales role where you personally owned a renewal or expansion number at a B2B software company.

 - A track record you can walk through: a specific account, what it was worth when you got it, what it was worth when you left it, and what you did.

 - Comfort with usage data: you can read an adoption dashboard and build a commercial argument out of it.

 - Ability to hold an executive conversation and a hard commercial one in the same meeting.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with consumption-based or usage-based pricing.

 - Experience with AI, LLMs, or Voice AI.

 - Startup experience.

 - Technical fluency: you can hold your own APIs, integrations, and deployment concepts with a customer's engineering team.




HOW WE EVALUATE

We care less about checkboxes and more about:

 - Whether you've actually owned a number, not supported someone who did.

 - Judgment in customer-facing moments, especially when something is broken and the renewal is close.

 - Whether you go find the expansion or wait for the customer to raise it.

 - How you reason from data: can you look at a consumption chart and tell us which account is about to churn and why.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF

 - You'd rather own the whole account than hand it off at the renewal.

 - You get more satisfaction from growing an account 3x than from a clean CSAT score.

 - You're comfortable pushing a customer toward a decision instead of waiting for them.

 - You like being close enough to the product to argue with the roadmap.

 - You move fast and don't need a playbook to already exist.




JOB DETAILS

Cash: $180,000 - $220,000

Equity: 4-year vest / 1-year cliff

Location: Redwood City, California, onsite (Relocation support provided)

US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, and F-1 (OPT/CPT).




OTHER BENEFITS

 - 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - $70/day DoorDash credit for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

 - $200/month wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, etc.)

 - $300/month commuter reimbursement (gas, Caltrain, etc.)

 - $75/month phone bill reimbursement

 - $50/month internet reimbursement




COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

 - Best offer upfront: Choose from three cash-equity balance options; no negotiation needed

 - Top 1% talent: Above-market pay (top 5th percentile) to attract exceptional builders

 - High ownership: small teams, >$1M revenue per employee, and significant equity

 - Performance-based: Offers tied to interview performance, not tenure or past salary




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Recruiter screen (30 min)

 - Account strategy walkthrough with the hiring manager (45 min)

 - Account management best practices (30 min)

 - Onsite (2.5 hrs): QBR simulation, escalation role play, usage analytics exercise & cross-functional and founder conversation

Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on Our Mission

As the Director of Patient Product Marketing, you'll be the strategic voice of the patient inside Zocdoc's Product Marketing organization. Reporting to our VP, Product Marketing, you'll own the overarching positioning, narrative, and GTM strategy for the entire patient-facing portfolio–defining how millions of consumers discover, choose, and come to trust Zocdoc. In this role, you will lead and scale a high-performing team of PMMs, pairing deep market insights with visionary audience strategies that accelerate customer adoption and long-term business growth. By staying ahead of where healthcare is going, you’ll paint a clear picture of the future for patients while helping to shape our product strategy. You will lead our PMM team into an AI-native era—championing automated GTM workflows and modern tool stacks that allow the team to scale efficiently and focus on high-impact work.

Your day-to-day is...

• Owning go-to-market strategy and positioning across our consumer portfolio, serving as strategic partner to design, product, and GMs, and bringing a sharp perspective on the exact consumer segments we should build for

• Leading and coaching a team of PMMs, setting the standard for audience strategy, messaging simplicity, and high-impact GTM execution

• Informing the product discovery with market context, validating user needs and competitive dynamics to ensure our roadmaps deliver clear patient value and strong product-market fit

• Championing the shift toward scalable GTM capabilities and AI-native ways of working to maximize business impact

You'll Enjoy This Role If You...

• Love turning complex user behaviors into clear, compelling positioning and GTM strategy

• Are energized by building and coaching a team of product marketers

• Can speak with equal fluency to a GM about market opportunity and to a product team about patient psychology and user experience

• Have an interest in transforming the healthcare experience for millions of patients

• Are comfortable being the accountable owner of a narrative that spans multiple products and teams

• Take pride in balancing big-picture strategy with the coaching and rigor it takes to bring a team along with you

You'll be successful in this role if you...

• Have 12–15+ years of relevant marketing experience, including 8+ years in product marketing and demonstrated success building and leading teams, including people managers

• Have deep experience with consumer products or marketplaces, ideally where trust, choice, and repeat engagement drive the business

• Have a track record of shaping company-level narrative and positioning, not just individual product launches

• Are a systematic coach who uses structured approaches to assess talent, build development plans, and recruit outside talent

• Can navigate ambiguity and competing priorities, making sound tradeoffs with incomplete information

• Are an exceptional communicator who can translate complex or sensitive topics for senior leaders and represent the function in high-visibility conversations

• Have applied external market and industry insight to sharpen positioning and drive performance

Benefits

• Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location

• Unlimited Vacation

• 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)

• Commuter Benefits

• 401(k) with employer funded match

• Corporate wellness program with Wellhub

• Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)

• Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement

• Cell phone reimbursement

• Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks

• Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging

• Great Place to Work Certified

Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

NYC Base Salary Range

$210,000—$270,000 USD

About us
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better.  We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. The Opportunity:

The Mattel Brand Creative team is seeking a Senior Manager, Creative to help shape how Mattel shows up in the world.

As Mattel continues to evolve as a global entertainment company, this role will help build, express, and scale the Mattel Masterbrand across a growing range of consumer, corporate, cultural, and experiential touchpoints.

This is a highly conceptual and hands-on creative leadership role for someone who can think at the brand level and bring ideas to life with exceptional craft. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing a big creative idea, building a visual system, directing an agency, designing alongside a team, and presenting work to senior stakeholders.

Working across Mattel’s portfolio of iconic brands, this person will help create a cohesive and recognizable Mattel brand presence while finding fresh, culturally relevant ways for the Masterbrand and our brands to come together.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Help define, evolve, and champion the creative expression of the Mattel Masterbrand across global touchpoints.
• Lead the development of breakthrough, idea-led creative that builds awareness, affinity, and recognition for Mattel and strengthens the connection between Mattel and its portfolio of iconic brands.
• Translate Mattel’s brand strategy and positioning into compelling creative ideas, visual storytelling, and brand experiences.
• Develop and scale Mattel’s visual identity system, establishing clear creative principles while continually finding new and unexpected ways for the brand to come to life.
• Lead creative across a wide range of work including integrated campaigns, social and digital, content, experiential, events, environments, corporate initiatives, partnerships, retail, packaging, and internal brand moments.
• Create work that can flex across audiences, from kids and families to adult fans, employees, partners, and the broader cultural community.
• Partner with Mattel’s individual brand teams to create moments where the Masterbrand and our portfolio of brands work together in a cohesive and meaningful way.
• Collaborate closely with Marketing, Communications, Consumer Products, Digital, Design, Content, Events, Workplace, and other cross-functional teams to build a consistent Mattel brand experience.
• Provide clear, inspiring creative direction to internal creative teams, agencies, freelancers, production partners, and vendors.
• Be hands on for both design, creative direction and on photoshoots. This role requires on-set production experience.
• Remain hands-on throughout the creative process, from concept development and design exploration through production and final execution.
• Identify opportunities to push the Mattel brand into new spaces, formats, partnerships, and cultural moments.
• Present and advocate for creative work with clarity and confidence to cross-functional partners and senior leadership.
• Manage multiple high-profile initiatives simultaneously, balancing creative ambition, business objectives, timelines, and budgets.
• Mentor and develop creative talent while helping foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, collaboration, and high creative standards.

What We’re Looking For:

Skills Required

• Conceptual creative thinker: Able to translate strategy and consumer insight into simple, powerful creative ideas with the ability to scale across channels.
• Exceptional design sensibility: Strong command of typography, composition, visual systems, storytelling, art direction, and craft.
• Brand builder: Understands how to build a distinctive global brand while creating enough flexibility for it to remain fresh, surprising, and culturally relevant.
• Hands-on creative leader: Comfortable moving between creative direction and making, with the ability to develop ideas visually and guide them through execution.
• Integrated thinker: Sees the brand experience holistically and understands how an idea can move across campaigns, content, social, digital, environments, experiences, retail, packaging, and emerging touchpoints.
• Culture-forward: Curious about entertainment, design, fashion, gaming, art, technology, social behavior, and broader culture, with an instinct for how brands can participate authentically.
• Multi-brand storyteller: Able to work across a portfolio of iconic brands while understanding how each brand’s individual equity can connect back to the larger Mattel story.
• Collaborative leader: Thrives in a highly matrixed organization and builds strong relationships across creative, marketing, design, communications, and business teams.
• Agency-savvy: Experienced in briefing, directing, challenging, and partnering with agencies and external creative talent to deliver exceptional work.
• Compelling communicator: Able to articulate the thinking behind creative work, build alignment, and confidently present to senior leadership.
• Creative problem solver: Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by assignments where the creative opportunity or solution has not yet been defined.

Core Capabilities

• Masterbrand and corporate brand development
• Brand identity and visual systems
• Creative concepting and art direction
• Integrated campaign development
• Brand storytelling and narrative development
• Digital and social creative
• Experiential, events, and environmental design
• Content, video, motion, and animation

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. jobs.title: Executive Functioning Coach - Contract/1099
jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

As an Executive Functioning Coach, you will provide evidence-based coaching to children, adolescents, and young adults facing daily challenges with executive functioning and task management. You will help clients build practical strategies to improve organization, planning, time management, task initiation, and independence across home, school, and community settings. Partnering closely with our interdisciplinary care team, you will implement individualized, skills-based plans that drive lasting functional outcomes.

We welcome candidates from backgrounds in Special Education, Reading/Learning Support, School Psychology, Counseling, Occupational Therapy, or Speech-Language Pathology to help clients build practical strategies for home, school, and community settings. This is a fully remote opportunity.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Deliver Virtual Coaching: Conduct 6–10 weekly virtual coaching sessions (45-minute sessions + 15-minute documentation).

• Build Real-World Tools: Create practical family resources, handouts, and actionable strategies to reinforce skill-building between sessions.

• Collaborate Interdisciplinarily: Partner with the Specialty Services Team and participate in weekly team consultations.

• Support Peak Hours: Maintain client availability during high-demand family times (weekday evenings between 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM or weekends).

What Makes You, You

• Subject Matter Depth: Strong understanding of executive dysfunction (ADHD, autism, learning differences, anxiety) and how it affects daily routines.

• Practical Strategist: Proven ability to translate complex cognitive concepts into simple, real-world tools tailored to a child's age and learning style.

• Collaborative Communicator: Excellent rapport-building skills with children, parents, and interdisciplinary care teams.

• Tech & Compliance Savvy: Comfortable navigating EMR platforms and managing patient records in compliance with HIPAA guidelines.

The Basics You’ll Need

• Education: Associate’s degree or higher in Special Education, Education, OT/COTA, SLP/SLPA, Counseling, Psychology, or a related human services field (equivalent practical experience considered).

• Experience: Direct experience supporting executive functioning, learning differences, or skill-building in educational, therapeutic, or pediatric settings.

• Licensure: No formal clinical license required; relevant professional certifications or credentials are welcomed.

Salary Range

$30—$35 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

jobs.title: Manager, Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As the Manager, Supply Chain, you will serve as a hands-on operational partner to the Head of Production in Quonset, driving planning, procurement oversight, and materials management for Anduril's Maritime Undersea Dominance product line. This is a lead-level role that blends individual contributor execution with team oversight. You will own the daily operational cadence, keeping production on track through master scheduling, demand planning, procurement triage, and warehouse coordination. The right person for this role is a strong planner first who can also step into procurement and materials work when needed, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and brings the kind of no-task-too-small mentality it takes to build and sustain a high-performing supply chain operation.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own production planning and material planning for the Quonset site, serving as the central point of accountability for master scheduling and demand/supply planning.

• Drive the day-to-day tactical planning rhythm, ensuring production has clear visibility into what is coming, what is needed, and when.

• Maintain accuracy across digital systems (Oracle on the supply side, Forge/Foundry on the production side), including rev rec verification and ensuring system data reflects reality on the floor.

• Partner directly with the Head of Production on daily battle rhythm, report-outs, and operational cadence to keep the site running smoothly.

• Identify planning gaps and build toward a scalable planning function over time, including informing future hiring needs such as a dedicated master scheduler.

• Provide oversight and monitoring of PO status across the procurement team, catching items that fall through the cracks and directing the team to triage effectively.

• Own visibility into supplier delivery performance, including on-time shipment tracking, inventory health, and escalation of shortages to Production Support Engineers (PSEs).

• Handle boots-on-the-ground procurement needs as they arise, including facilities-related purchases, COTS items, and miscellaneous material requirements that pop up outside standard production procurement flows.

• Provide light oversight and mentoring for materials and warehouse operations at the Quonset site.

• Serve as the connective tissue between operations teams, ensuring alignment on inventory management, material flow, and warehouse priorities.

• Understand and work within Anduril's 3Si (Shared Site Services) model as it relates to planning and warehousing functions.

• Facilitate rather than direct, this pillar is about ensuring coordination and removing blockers rather than day-to-day IC execution.

• Serve as a key stakeholder and operational partner to the Head of Production, providing daily visibility into supply chain health and contributing to site-level decision making.

• Work closely with Anduril's Accounting, Finance, and Legal teams to ensure timely supplier payment, contracting, and financing.

• Collaborate with Anduril's broader US-based Supply Chain organization to leverage existing processes, best practices, and strategies.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5+ years of experience in supply chain with a strong emphasis on production planning, material planning, or master scheduling within a manufacturing environment.

• Demonstrated ability to manage demand and supply planning processes and keep production teams informed and unblocked.

• Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems; familiarity with Oracle is a plus.

• Working knowledge of procurement processes, supplier management, and inventory management.

• Comfort operating as both a lead-level individual contributor and a people leader, with the ability to mentor and oversee small teams.

• Strong cross-functional communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with production, engineering, and finance stakeholders.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, unstructured environment where priorities shift quickly. Startup or high-growth experience preferred.

• Positive attitude, bias for action, and a no-task-too-small mentality.

• Bachelor's degree preferred, not required.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a US Security Clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience in a technically complex industry such as aerospace, defense, automotive, or consumer electronics.

• Prior experience standing up or scaling supply chain operations in a growing organization.

• Experience with AS9100D guidelines.

• Familiarity with shared services or multi-site supply chain operating models.

• Track record of building operational cadences, KPIs, and reporting rhythms from the ground up.

US Salary Range

$111,000—$147,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Proposal Specialist (Government)
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Proposal Specialist with at least five years of proposal support of proposal management experience, preferable in the SaaS or technology industry. The ideal candidate has APMP certification or equivalent experience, along with experience developing and submitting government proposal responses, navigating government procurement portals and supporting similar proposal development processes. You are highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable managing multiple deadlines and collaborating with cross-functional teams. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Proposal Specialist, you will perform a broad range of duties as a member of the RFX team. Your responsibilities include assisting with the development and management of proposals, bids, quotations, and government proposal responses for Geotab’s reselling partners and customers. You will coordinate proposal timelines, requirements, content collection, reviews, approvals, and submissions. You will also respond to vendor and security questionnaires and other documents describing Geotab’s products and services. You will navigate government procurement portals and ensure submissions meet all requirements and deadlines. In addition, you will support proposal-related projects focused on improving processes, tools, resources, and deadlines. You will collaborate with internal teams to gather accurate and relevant proposal content, support Senior Proposal/RFP Managers on large opportunities, and assist with monthly reporting and other administrative tasks.

How you'll make an impact:

• Regular utilize AI to create work efficiencies and tools to drive velocity

• Assist other RFX team members leading proposals in a supporting role

• Assist with the training of new hires/interns and maintenance of the RFX Team Training Materials and Manuals

• Contribute to RFX Team Projects, RFX content creation/refresh and update, and annual Team KPAs

• Support the RFX Team’s content management process by updating and drafting content, as needed

• Perform administrative tasks, contribute to the RFX Quarterly Report, and support the rest of the RFX team with tasks, as required.

• Participate in strategic review exercises to assess the efficacy of Geotab’s RFX activities.

• Responsiveness outside core hours may be needed during critical periods

What you'll bring to the role:

• 3 - 5 years of required previous experience in sales operations, proposal management

• Experience in sales operations/proposal management

• Experience working within a technical, SaaS, or engineering organization - knowledge of the high-technology industry is an asset.

• Proficient in using AI and quick to adapt to new technologies

• Strong communication skills, especially with writing, proofreading, and editing

• Self-motivated to learn, improve and share/receive feedback

• High accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.

• Able to work well under pressure and respond to fast changing priorities and deadlines.

• Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.

• Strong interpersonal relationship building skills.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to problem solve and make sound decisions.

• A strong team-player with the ability to engage with all levels of the organization.

• Technical competence using software programs, including, but not limited to, Google Suite for business (Sheets, Docs, Slides), Adobe Professional, and various AI tools

• Experience with CRM Tools (e.g. Salesforce) and other tools/systems (e.g. Jira, Loopio, etc. )

• Entrepreneurial mindset and comfortable in a flat organization.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
